title: Vertical restriction of a Segal space is an inner fibration
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, quasicategories, inner horns and degreewise products of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], Reedy fibrancy of [lem-coef-reedy-model-structure], and homotopy Segal spaces of [lem-coef-segal-dk-diagonal-equivalence]. Let $W:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{sSet}$ be Reedy fibrant and homotopy Segal. For any small simplicial set $T$ define a simplicial set $W/T$ by
$$(W/T)_p=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{sSet}}(T,W_p),$$
with its operators induced by those of $W$; this is an ordinary set of simplicial maps in each outer degree, not the vertical simplicial mapping space. Then $W/T$ is a quasicategory for every $T$. For every degreewise injective simplicial map $v:S\hookrightarrow T$, restriction $W/T\to W/S$ is an inner fibration: every commutative square with $\Lambda_i^n\hookrightarrow\Delta^n$ on the left, $0<i<n$, has a diagonal filler. Neither completeness of $W$ nor a Kan condition on $S,T$ is assumed.

source.place: Joyal–Tierney, Quasi-categories vs Segal spaces, Proposition 3.4 and Proposition 3.10, specializing the latter to W -> terminal; notation of Section 2. Read online 2026-10-17; archive WANTED in report.md. No Stacks tag states this bisimplicial homotopy theorem.
